scenarios.observation: Indicator lamp is dark; device has power; adjacent status display is blank.
scenarios.manual_excerpt: If the indicator is dark while the device is powered, check the indicator fuse before replacing the control board.

scenarios.observation: Motor hums briefly, then stops; intake grille is visibly obstructed.
scenarios.manual_excerpt: For a brief motor start followed by shutdown, remove power and clear the intake obstruction before testing the motor.
scenarios.near_miss: Run the motor repeatedly to determine whether it recovers.
scenarios.expected_first_check: remove power and clear the intake obstruction

scenarios.observation: Output is uneven; reservoir level is low; no leak is visible around the housing.
scenarios.manual_excerpt: Uneven output with a low reservoir and no external leak indicates an insufficient supply level; refill to the marked line before adjusting the regulator.
